DRAFT for Gideon Sato: Hartford incident summary (for Mateo's procurement team)

Incident: Gate kiosks offline at Vantorre's Hartford plant on Monday, Aug 3, 2026. Both inbound lanes showed a white screen after badge scan. Gate check-in was affected; scheduling still worked from the dispatch office.

- First report: 10:42 AM, Aug 3 (incident room #inc-vtg-hartford)
- Kiosk 1 back: 11:03 AM, Aug 3 (guard checked in trailer 8836; dispatch confirmed it)
- Both lanes confirmed working: 11:07 AM, Aug 3

Open items: incident left open for another arrival cycle. Status-page access for Mateo's account is still being chased (ticket INC-4821). Carrowmere Cloud was checking the Hartford gateway route; the reconnect log has gone to Odile Brandt.
